protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: Real CWE-91 injection, not withdrawn. GHSA-f6ww-3ggp-fr8h (withdrawn_at null) and CVE-2026-41674 (cveMetadata.state=PUBLISHED, CNA GitHub_M) describe the same source-to-sink: programmatic DocumentType.publicId/systemId/internalSubset stored verbatim by createDocumentType, then XMLSerializer.serializeToString concatenates those fields into the DOCTYPE with no grammar check. A quote or '>' in publicId/systemId, or ']>' in internalSubset, terminates or rewrites the declaration so attacker markup/declarations appear outside the intended DOCTYPE; a downstream parser with entity expansion can then take XXE-class impact. Parse path is out of scope (SAX PubidLiteral/SystemLiteral). Live sink at 0.9.9 lib/dom.js DOCUMENT_TYPE_NODE (buf.push of pubid/sysid/internalSubset then '>').

Its DOCUMENT_TYPE_NODE hunk deletes the shadowed `var buf = ['<!DOCTYPE ',nodeName]` and writes `buf.push('<!DOCTYPE ',node.name)`, after which unchecked publicId/systemId/internalSubset are appended to the caller-owned buffer that serializeToString joins. Earlier 5fb8fb92b2cb9d7c6b8b5477900e90619b14e432 first drafted the same formatter text, but reassigned the helper parameter to a local array that is never joined; that draft is dead code, not the BIC. Later 726b47117ae19e497a2c8c89908cc0bee7fb2e51 / 0.9.0 createDocumentType(internalSubset) only expand reachability.
